text: What if Dave grew one inch taller every day? After one year, he's eleven metres tall. Six times bigger in every direction. But weight grows with the cube. He's over two hundred times heavier. His bones only grow with the square. Thirty-six times stronger. That's the square-cube law. Every step puts six times the stress on his legs. Galileo worked it out in sixteen thirty-eight. It's why giants can't exist. Dave took one more step.
